name: OTSeaStaking
fix_description: In _claimMultiple, validate that _indexes array contains no duplicates, or use a mapping to track already-claimed indexes within the same transaction to prevent double-claiming rewards.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a straightforward repeated abuse of staking claim/withdraw logic using crafted index arrays, followed by a simple token dump on Uniswap. It does not require flash loans, price manipulation, or deep cross-protocol reasoning; once the indexing/accounting bug is identified, writing the exploit is relatively quick.
